options.name: as_dict
options.description: When C(true) (the default), each result row is returned as a dictionary keyed by column name. When C(false), rows are returned as positional tuples.

options.name: db
options.description: Filename of the SQLite database file. Combined with I(path) using C(os.path.join) to form the full path.

options.name: fetch_one
options.description: When C(true), return only the first row of the result set instead of all rows. If there are no rows, an empty list is returned.

options.name: named_args
options.description: Dictionary of values bound to SQLite named placeholders (C(:name)) inside I(query). Use this instead of formatting values into the SQL string to avoid injection.

options.name: path
options.description: Directory the database file lives in. Combined with I(db) to form the full path.

options.name: query
options.description: The SQL C(SELECT) statement to run. Use named placeholders (C(:name)) for any user-provided values and pass them through I(named_args).

options.name: query_type
options.description: Type of SQL query to run. Currently only C(select) is implemented; the option exists to leave room for future write-capable variants.
